text_en: A Song. A Psalm of the Korahites.
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God. His holy mountain,
text_cn: 在我们天主的城池中， 上主至大，应受到赞颂。

text_en: beautiful in elevation, is the joy of all the earth, Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King.
text_cn: 他的圣山巍峨高耸，是普世的欢喜， 北方中心熙雍圣山，是大王的城邑。

text_en: Within its citadels God has shown himself a sure defense.
text_cn: 天主居于堡垒的中央， 显自己为稳固的保障。

text_en: Then the kings assembled, they came on together.
text_cn: 请看，众王纷纷相聚， 他们蜂拥走向前去，

text_en: As soon as they saw it, they were astounded; they were in panic, they took to flight;
text_cn: 他们一见，惊魂丧胆， 张惶失措，抱头鼠窜。

text_en: trembling took hold of them there, pains as of a woman in labor,
text_cn: 他们在那里惶惧恐怖， 苦痛有如临盆的孕妇；

text_en: as when an east wind shatters the ships of Tarshish.
text_cn: 好像塔尔史士的船只， 为强烈的东风所袭击。

text_en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God, which God establishes forever. Selah
text_cn: 在万军上主的城里，即我们天主的城堡， 我们所见正如所闻：天主必使城堡永固。 （休止）

text_en: We ponder your steadfast love, O God, in the midst of your temple.
text_cn: 天主，我们在你的殿里， 沉思默念着你的仁慈；

text_en: Your name, O God, like your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is filled with victory.
text_cn: 天主，你的名号远达地极， 你受的赞美亦应该如此。 你的右手全充满了正义，

text_en: Let Mount Zion be glad, let the towns of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
text_cn: 愿熙雍山因你的公正而喜乐； 犹大女子也要因此欢欣踊跃。

text_en: Walk about Zion, go all around it, count its towers,
text_cn: 你们环绕熙雍巡游， 你们数点她的城楼，

text_en: consider well its ramparts; go through its citadels, that you may tell the next generation
text_cn: 观察她的城廓，巡视她的碉堡， 是为叫你们向后代子孙陈述：

text_en: that this is God, our God forever and ever. He will be our guide forever.
text_cn: 他的确是伟大的天主， 也永远是我们的天主， 始终领导我们的天主。
